data.name: Elementalist Class (Legacy)
data.summary: This mod adds the Elementalist Class, a class focused purely on elements and elemental damage. Features 3 subclasses, many altered spells and passives, and full progression to lvl 12.

modfile.changelog:
This is the final Balancing Patch! The base mod is complete! I will be working on additional spells, and equipment for the class but update frequency will slow down quite a bit. Hopefully this will help the base class mod make its way to console!

Thank you all for your feedback, and I look forward to doing more with the Elementalist Class!

Balancing:
- Increased the Elemental Spark Cost of Elemental Smites and Empowered Smites from 2 to 5, and 3 to 6 respectively. 
- Added a status effect for each of the Empowered Smites, so they all inflict a status effect now!

data.name: P4_Eye_Colours
data.summary: This mod includes all the eye colour presets I make or put together. They support also more parameters than the default eye colours do, to support race mods that utilise these parameters. Such as Ghost_Colour, GlowColor and GlowColour

modfile.changelog:
Added 10 new options inspired by Halloween
Added parameters for ******* GlowBrightness	
- GlowBrightnessPupil	
- FxMasking	
- FlameDirection	
- FlameSpeed	
- Blindness	
- Blindness_L	
Where needed these are all set to 0 that way they do not get these values "applied" from other eyes that use them.	
This means they won't show blindness/glow after selecting an eye with blindness/glow, since that value does not get applied once in game, unless the eye colour itself has those values.	
This way less confusion when selecting eye colours.

When remaking in toolkit, I copied the values into the wrong section which caused them to come out brighter than they were previously.

This update rectifies that, by adding back the original 20 versions I made before the toolkit version. They are added as new options, as to not affect anyone's games who are using the ones that were added in the tooklit version.
